strategy.chosen_strategy: Strategy A: Joint Generation (Features + Post-Drift Target Churn)
strategy.justification: Post-drift B200 contains only 76 minority ('No') and 124 majority ('Yes') records. Splitting 200 samples across 19 features into class-specific pools causes severe sample starvation, extreme mode collapse, and numerical instability. Joint generation trains on all 200 records and enables direct empirical evaluation of macroscopic conditional associations.

validation_tiers.Tier_2_Hard_Constraints: Physical ranges (tenure in [0, 72], non-negative charges), unique candidates, 0 exact B200 copies, 0 forbidden signature overlaps
validation_tiers.Tier_3_Empirical_Plausibility: Billing ratio screen in [0.5, 1.5], continuous KS-test, categorical TVD, DCR p05 nearest-neighbor privacy
